points.label: Oaths in view
points.left: The psalm joins an oath with a priest forever
points.right: Hebrews joins God’s oath to Abraham with hope, entry, and Jesus’ priesthood

points.label: Movement after the oath
points.left: The LORD addresses the psalmist’s Lord, promises rule, swears an unchanging oath, and names a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.
points.right: God’s promise and oath to Abraham lead to hope as an anchor, Jesus as forerunner, and a high priest forever after Melchizedek’s order.

payload.posture: Read both passages while keeping each speaker, setting, action, and later argument in its own setting.

rightEvidence.title: Hebrews joins God’s oath to Abraham with hope, entry, and Jesus’ priesthood

payload.tension: Hebrews places the Melchizedek saying at the end of a movement from promise and oath to hope and entry.
payload.title: Oath in the psalm and hope within the veil
